svg:
Double Doppler: reflection from moving wall / vehicle – echo
wall v_w →
source f
<line x1="120" y1="130" x2="290" y2="140" stroke="#1f5fa8" stroke-width:1" stroke-dasharray="5 3"/>
<line x1="120" y1="150" x2="290" y2="140" stroke="#0b7a4b" stroke-width:1"/> incident: wall is moving observer reflected: wall is moving source f1 = f * (v + v_w)/(v - v_s) [wall as observer] f2 = f1 * v/(v - v_w) = f * (v+v_w)/(v - v_s) * v/(v - v_w?) For stationary source v_s=0, stationary observer at source: f_echo = f * (v+v_w)/(v - v_w) ≈ f*(1+2v_w/v) for v_w≪v If observer also moving, apply again: f'' = f * (v+v_o)/(v - v_s) * (v+v_w)/(v - v_w) etc. Valid: wall large vs λ, specular reflection, v_w < v, no wind. Double shift is product of two single shifts.
